title: Masterpieces
description: A collection of real-world masterpieces turned into Minecraft paintings. Display iconic artworks in your castles, galleries, and mansions.
body:
# Masterpieces

**This will not work on its own you need to install the resourcepack available at this link : [Click here to go to the resourcepack's page](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/masterpieces-resourcepack)**

Bring the world's most famous paintings into Minecraft.

Masterpieces adds real-world works of art as new placeable Minecraft paintings. From Renaissance classics to Impressionist icons, you can decorate your builds with carefully scaled versions of legendary artworks.

Perfect for museums, mansions, castles, libraries, and galleries.

## Features

- Adds 17 real world paintings
- All of them are sized to real world scale (as best as possible with 1m = 1 block)
- Keeps the vanilla feel with 16 pixel per block


## Artworks

Version 1.0.0 adds 17 paintings from painters such as Leonardo Da Vinci, Michelangelo, Van Gogh, Francisco de Goya, Edvard Munch and more.


<details>
<summary>Full list</summary>
  
- Sunflowers by Vincent van Gogh (1x1)
  
- Impression, Sunrise by Claude Monet (2x1)
  
- Mona Lisa by Leonardo da Vinci (1x2)
  
- The Last Supper by Leonardo da Vinci (8x4)
  
- The Night Watch by Rembrandt van Rijn (4x3)
  
- The Card Players by Paul Cézanne (1x1)
  
- The Scream by Edvard Munch (1x2)
  
- The Birth of Venus by Sandro Botticelli (3x2)
  
- Girl with a Pearl Earring by Johannes Vermeer (1x1)
  
- The Dance Class by Edgar Degas (1x1)
  
- Liberty Leading the People by Eugène Delacroix (3x2)
  
- The Raft of the Medusa by Théodore Géricault (7x5)
  
- The Starry Night by Vincent van Gogh (2x1)
  
- The Creation of Adam by Michelangelo (6x3)
  
- The Last Judgment by Michelangelo (12x14)
  
- The Third of May 1808 by Francisco de Goya (3x3)
  
- The Oath of the Horatii by Jacques-Louis David (4x3)
  
</details>
